name: ibex_core_ng45
display_name: Global controller: an ibex RV32 core (ORFS nangate45, 45 nm)

area.note: Low and nominal MEASURED: ORFS instance area (finish__design__instance__area, standard cells, no macros) of the stock nangate45 ibex design (ibex_core, RV32IMC, its own config.mk at a 2.2 ns clock), run on the probe's image openroad/orfs sha256:ebc8142d (the image of the study's tile, RA/06_build/audit_v4/pd.md sec. 2) on sura CPUs 32-39 under an 8 GB cap, 2026-10-28 (RA/11_wave2/final_units/ua/probes/orfs/ibex/6_report.json; redo: final_units/ua/scripts/run_orfs_ref.sh ibex <dir>): 29,357.1 um2, the same instance-area basis as the study's tile. High: Simba's RISC-V processor partition, 109K um2 synthesis area at 16 nm (shao2019simba Table 3 p.5), scaled to 45 nm by the logic rule ((45/16)^2 = 7.910): 862,207 um2, a larger RV64 controller. The controller's instruction and data memories are not included (not priced).
